audit_findings.test: Sample admin accounts and verify MFA and role need
audit_findings.finding: Partial evidence of strong privileged controls
audit_findings.recommendation: Enforce MFA/PAM and review admin rights quarterly

audit_findings.test: Check endpoint coverage and perform sample restore
audit_findings.finding: Controls are planned, but full proof is not available
audit_findings.recommendation: Close patch gaps and test immutable backup recovery

audit_findings.evidence_requested: Network diagram, VLAN and firewall rules
audit_findings.test: Trace guest-to-internal paths and review rules
audit_findings.finding: Separate networks exist, but weak separation is still a risk
audit_findings.recommendation: Tighten firewall rules and isolate OT/BMS networks

audit_findings.evidence_requested: User list, firmware record, login logs
audit_findings.test: Check default/shared accounts and remote admin access
audit_findings.recommendation: Remove shared/default accounts and enforce MFA

audit_findings.test: Review remote maintenance route and allowed systems
audit_findings.finding: Remote access and isolation need stronger control
audit_findings.recommendation: Use jump host, MFA and allow-listing for maintenance

audit_findings.test: Sample roles, storage permissions and exposed services
audit_findings.recommendation: Run regular configuration checks and reduce privileges

audit_findings.test: Sample vendors and compare access with contract need
audit_findings.finding: Formal vendor control evidence is limited
audit_findings.recommendation: Maintain vendor register, expiry dates and access reviews

audit_findings.test: Check critical sources and test one alert path
audit_findings.finding: SOC exists, but coverage gaps are still possible
audit_findings.recommendation: Track log coverage and test alerts on a schedule
